entities.summary: Giuseppe Maria Graniello, C.R.S.P., sometimes Granniello was an Italian prelate of the Catholic Church who taught theology for two decades and led his order, the Barnabites, for twelve years, and then worked in the Roman Curia for several years. He became an archbishop in 1892 and a cardinal in 1893.
